acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered owner-accepted requirements in the owning spec (application-map-v0, application-navigation-ledger-v0 or application-flow-understanding-v1), with focused tests or measured evidence tracing each.
Missing or unresolvable evidence yields an explicit UNKNOWN, abstention or full-suite fallback, never invented certainty; read commands stay read-only, local and offline.
body:
Competitor/source: Datadog unskippable tests https://docs.datadoghq.com/tests/test_impact_analysis/ , Develocity always-selected tests https://docs.develocity.ai/predictive-test-selection .

Gap: AFU-V1-019..023 have no project-owned way to pin a test as always selected.

Proposal: an owner-declared marker (annotation, tag or manifest entry) that keeps the test selected under every exclusion basis, named as such in the selection report. Report: scratchpad appmap-competitive-research.md (2026-10-10 competitive research).
title: e2e-safe: owner-declared must-run markers that no exclusion basis can override
